_note: Sources for Form 3 Maths (content/classes.json, form-3). Rules are computed by src/engine/lib/maths.js and maths2.js (poly, mono, bracket, br).

algebra-simplify.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: algebraic expressions (simplification, expansion); standard algebra conventions (like terms, laws of indices for products and quotients of terms, distributive law)
algebra-simplify.checked: Answers computed by the engine from the distributive law and index laws; checked by 1000-seed tests.

algebra-expand.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: expansion of algebraic expressions; identities (a + b)², (a − b)², (a + b)(a − b)
algebra-expand.checked: Answers computed by the engine from the distributive law; checked by 1000-seed tests.

algebra-factorise.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: factorisation (common factor, grouping, quadratic trinomials, difference of two squares)
algebra-factorise.checked: Every factorised answer is generated from its factors and its expansion is checked by the tests (1000 seeds).

algebra-equations.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: solving linear equations (brackets, unknowns on both sides, fractions)
algebra-equations.checked: Equations are built from a chosen integer solution; the engine verifies each answer.

simultaneous.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: simultaneous linear equations (elimination, substitution, graphical meaning)
simultaneous.checked: Each pair of equations is built from a chosen integer solution; the engine checks it in both equations.

word-problems.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: building and solving equations from real-life problems
word-problems.checked: Problems are generated from their solution; answers verified by the engine (1000 seeds).

quadratic-equations.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: quadratic equations by factorisation and by the quadratic formula; discriminant
quadratic-equations.checked: Roots computed from the factors or the formula; tests check every variant.

formulae.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: transposition of formulae (change of subject)
formulae.checked: Rearranged formulae are authored (each wrong option explained); numerical substitutions are computed by the engine.

variation.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: direct, inverse, joint and partial variation; graphs
variation.checked: Constants of variation and answers computed from the given pairs; formula choices authored.

pythagoras.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: right-angled triangles and Pythagoras' theorem and its converse
pythagoras.checked: Sides from integral Pythagorean triples (maths2.js TRIPLES) or computed square roots.

trigonometry.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: trigonometric ratios of acute angles, complementary angles, special angles (30°, 45°, 60°), calculators, solving right-angled triangles, elevation and depression
trigonometry.checked: Ratios and angles computed with sinD/cosD/tanD and their inverses (maths2.js, tested); exact values authored.

matrices.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: matrices (definition, types, addition, subtraction, scalar and matrix multiplication, transpose, determinant, adjoint, inverse of a 2 × 2 matrix)
matrices.checked: All results computed by maths2.js (matAdd, matMul, det2, adj2, matT; tested); matrix types authored.

congruence.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: congruency, congruent plane figures, congruency in triangles (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS)
congruence.checked: Definitions, tests and proof reasons authored (each wrong option explained); lengths and angles computed.

similarity.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: similar figures, scale factor, areas and volumes of similar figures, Thales property and its converse, applications (maps, models)
similarity.checked: Lengths, areas (k²) and volumes (k³) computed by the engine; similarity facts authored.

indices-logs.ref: Form 3 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1: laws of indices (zero, negative, fractional), simple exponential equations, laws of logarithms, simple logarithmic equations
indices-logs.checked: Powers and logarithms computed by the engine (^, logb in maths2.js, tested); log 2 ≈ 0.3010 and the powers of ten in the log tables are authored.
